ballots.name: Noor
ballots.reason: Version 1 permits preparation-time authority without verified isolation, credential restrictions, or resource limits, which owner approval at installation does not address.

ballots.name: Jonas
ballots.reason: Version 1 lacks the evidence threshold, intake cap, and preparation-time safeguards the group converged on, so I support only the amended version, not the motion as written.

ballots.name: Lena
ballots.reason: Version 1 provides no evidence threshold, no per-agent cap, no consolidation step, and no verified preparation-time safeguards, so it adds an unbounded intake source to the owner's review queue without any of the controls I identified as necessary.
